items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: we used to go there because they played the kind of music that we played

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. I get names all mixed up. Yeah, well, I used to go to Ryan's and hear them.

Yeah, well, that's what I said. Sidney De Parry. Two brothers, three stars, yeah. Uh, bands like that, I mean, we used to go there because they played the kind of music that we played. I mean, uh, I mean, the, the style that, uh, that we liked. You know.
